How to read this globe
The surface is NASA's Blue Marble satellite mosaic; NASA's city lights appear on the night side only in the modern era. Clouds thicken during cold periods. Sandy-green shelves are seabed that was dry land while sea level was low. White caps are ice sheets, simplified. Sea level follows published reconstructions (after Lambeck and colleagues, 2014). Glowing dots streaming along routes are migrating peoples. Colored dots are register records: coral for places, gold for religious stories, teal for artifacts and fossils, lavender for claims and myths. The 3D scenes are interpretive reconstructions built for this page, not photographs or archaeological surveys. Each record links to real photos.
